title: The Abandoned Base
description: Commander Elena Rost of Concord Intelligence has received intelligence that the abandoned Rebel base on Caldon may still contain classified information from the early days of the Alliance. The Iron Dominion discovered the base during the war, but some data may have been missed. The base is dangerous—old security systems, possible Dominion traps, maybe even Dominion Remnant activity. But the intelligence could be invaluable.
shortDescription: Recover classified intelligence from the abandoned Rebel base

objectives.description: Travel to the abandoned Rebel base
Reach the command center deep within the base where classified data is stored
Obtain security override key (search defeated enemies or find in security office)
Recover Rebel intelligence datapads from the command center
Return the intelligence to Commander Rost
